children: Organon reported positive interim Phase 3 results for MIUDELLA, a hormone-free copper IUD, with a 6-year Pearl Index of 0.93 and a 6-year KM pregnancy rate of 3.9%. The FDA is reviewing an sNDA for use up to 6 years, with a PDUFA action expected in Q2 2027.

Confirms long-term effectiveness, key for payer/provider adoption.
sNDA under FDA review to 6 years

PDUFA action expected Q2 2027

REMS program required for insertion
